sources.snippet: It has the same model structure as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, i.e. it comes with a speculative decoding module attached. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) on benchmarks listed below despite its far smaller activated parameter count, and is broadly competitive with the strongest proprietary models available.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is an AI model released by DeepSeek on Friday, Jul 31 2026, 98 days after DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Benchmark results (shown below) cover BullshitBench v2, Terminal-Bench 2.1, Toolathlon-Verified, CyberGym, and AutomationBench.
